outcome: Inequalities in maternal health service utilization
cohort: Women who gave birth 3-5 years prior to each survey year (1994, 1996, 2001, 2006, 2011) in Nepal
finding: While the use of maternal health services increased in Nepal between 1994 and 2011, inequalities in service utilization persist, particularly related to wealth, education, and geographic location.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarean section deliveries increased from 1% in 1994 to 6% in 2011, with significant inequality in C-section rates observed based on wealth quintile.
